title: Blood and Silk: The Complete Saga
description: The full Blood and Silk campaign arc - from exile in Silkstrand to the Bronze Gate. Follow a group of exiles as they carve a place for themselves in the broken world of Fate's Edge. This saga includes The Velvet War of Silkstrand (prequel), Blood and Silk (Millhaven), Beyond Millhaven (the Valvano Ford), and The Brass Gate (Castra Ferrum).
author: Nicholas A. Gasper

bestiary.name: Garrick Ursillo
bestiary.description: A cruel bandit leader with a personal code of honour. He is a veteran fighter with scars that tell stories of countless battles. His sword is well-maintained and deadly, and his eyes burn with the fury of a man who has lost everything.

sb_spends.name: Tactical Awareness
sb_spends.effect: Redirect an attack to a minion (once per round).

sb_spends.name: Berserker Rage
sb_spends.effect: When wounded to Harm 2, gains +1 die to all attacks but loses defensive options.

bestiary.lore: A faded brand on his forearm marks him as a deserter from the Vhasian army – a secret he kills to protect.

bestiary.name: Ursillo Bandit
bestiary.description: A common thug in Garrick's gang. They fight with crude weapons and intimidation.

bestiary.name: Factor Voss
bestiary.description: A mid-level Aeler bureaucrat under audit. He is desperate to show revenue and save face.

bestiary.name: Captain Rusk
bestiary.description: A pragmatic Black Banner mercenary captain who sells steel to whoever can pay. He is haunted by a promise made to a dying legionary.

sb_spends.name: Weathered Soldier
sb_spends.effect: Ignore one point of Fatigue for the scene.

sb_spends.name: Call in Favours
sb_spends.effect: Summon a squad of mercenaries (Cap 2) to assist.

bestiary.lore: He carries Varus's badge of rank and owes a debt to a smuggler named Peyton.

bestiary.name: Khatun Sarnai
bestiary.description: The proud and grieving chieftain of the Ykrul Gray Ash clan. She respects those who keep their word.

sb_spends.name: Hunting Cry
sb_spends.effect: Allies gain +1 die on their next attack.

sb_spends.name: Steppe Tactics
sb_spends.effect: The party gains Dominant Position for the next exchange.

bestiary.secret: Her daughter Yelü is the child of a legionary who defected.

bestiary.name: Quick Lena
bestiary.description: A Sidhi rogue with mismatched eyes and a nervous laugh. She works for Rusk, not out of loyalty but desperation.

sb_spends.name: Light Fingers
sb_spends.effect: Steal a weapon mid‑combat (Wits+Subterfuge vs target's Wits+Notice).

sb_spends.name: Always Another Exit
sb_spends.effect: Escape a scene without a roll (once per session).

bestiary.secret: She was an apprentice of the Silk Coin who ran when the Velvet Court came.

bestiary.name: Prefect Gaius Marcellus
bestiary.description: Commander of Castra Ferrum, a wiry, scarred veteran with a voice like a parade ground. He genuinely believes the seal will bring peace – and consolidate his power.

sb_spends.name: Legionary Discipline
sb_spends.effect: Allies gain +1 die to resist Fear.

sb_spends.name: Invoke the Curse
sb_spends.effect: Target must test Resolve or gain Varus's Whispers ( –1 die to resist persuasion).

bestiary.secret: He leads a cult of oathbreakers who worship Varus's ghost. His younger brother died in a Ykrul raid.

bestiary.name: Censor Cassia
bestiary.description: A thin, aging woman with ink‑stained fingers. Her left eye is a polished silver disc – a magical lens that reveals lies.

sb_spends.name: Silver Eye
sb_spends.effect: Automatically detect Deception of DV 4 or less.

sb_spends.name: Archive Secrets
sb_spends.effect: Gain +2 dice on Lore rolls for the rest of the scene.

bestiary.secret: She is dying of a slow fever; destroying the seal is her last act.

bestiary.name: Ghost of the Ninth Legion's Commander
bestiary.description: The betrayed commander of the Ninth Hispania Legion, now a vengeful spirit bound to the Iron Seal.

sb_spends.name: Cry of Betrayal
sb_spends.effect: All in Near range must test Spirit or be Shaken ( –1 die).

sb_spends.name: The Ninth Clause
sb_spends.effect: If the ghost speaks his own name, the curse ends.

bestiary.name: The Silken Blade
bestiary.description: A masked enforcer of the Velvet Court, armed with a poisoned stiletto. She is the Court's most deadly assassin.

sb_spends.name: Poisoned Blade
sb_spends.effect: Target tests Resolve or gains 1 Fatigue.

bestiary.name: Black Banner Mercenary Squad
bestiary.description: A squad of professional sellswords. They fight as a unit.

sb_spends.name: Coordinated Strike
sb_spends.effect: Gain +1 die on all attacks for the round.

acts.title: Prologue: The Velvet War of Silkstrand
acts.description: The fall of the Silk Coin, a principled thieves' guild. The player characters make choices that cost them their place in Silkstrand. Their Legacy Tokens carry into the main adventure.

scenes.title: The Velvet Court's Gambit
scenes.description: Madam Serafine has declared the Silk Coin a threat to her operations. The guildhall is surrounded. Old Kes urges the characters to flee while they still can. The players must decide: stand and fight for a doomed cause, or run and carry the Silk Coin's legacy into exile.

timers.name: The Court's Net
timers.description: How quickly the Velvet Court closes in

outcomes.clean: You escape with a valuable Legacy Token - a parting gift that will serve you in exile.
outcomes.partial: You escape, but the Court takes something: a name, a memory, a promise. Gain a Debt timer.
outcomes.miss: You are captured and must bargain your way free. Begin with a String of obligation to Serafine.

scenes.title: The City You Left Behind
scenes.description: Silkstrand is a city of bridges and dyewater. The Matron rules from a palazzo of velvet and iron. Your names no longer appear on guild rolls. Your friends have forgotten your faces - or claim they have.

scenes.title: The Road to Exile
scenes.description: You have been erased. The road ahead is uncertain. Millhaven is just a name on a map - a chance to start over where no one knows your story. Or so you believe.

acts.title: Act I: Blood and Silk - The Defense of Millhaven
acts.description: The exiles arrive in Millhaven, a farming village threatened by the Ursillo Gang. They must earn the villagers' trust, defend the settlement, and decide whether to stand and fight or flee once more.

scenes.title: Arrival at Millhaven
scenes.description: The party arrives at Millhaven to find a village under siege. Elder Thorne explains the Ursillo Gang's demands and the villagers' dwindling options. The party must decide: help the village or move on?

timers.name: Village Safety
timers.description: How close the village is to being overrun

timers.name: Ursillo Threat
timers.description: How much the Ursillo Gang is organizing against the village

outcomes.clean: Thorne trusts you immediately. Gain the Elder's Trust asset.
outcomes.partial: Thorne is cautious but willing to give you a chance.
outcomes.miss: Thorne sees you as just more trouble. You must prove yourselves.

scenes.title: The Ursillo Gang's Ultimatum
scenes.description: Garrick Ursillo and his men arrive to collect 'protection money.' The villagers have nothing left to give. The party must choose: pay the gang, fight them, or negotiate.

outcomes.clean: Garrick is impressed by your defiance. He leaves - for now. Gain a String: Garrick's Respect.
outcomes.partial: Garrick reduces his demand but takes a hostage. Tick Village Safety +1.
outcomes.miss: Garrick attacks immediately. Combat begins.

scenes.title: The Strategic Crossroads
scenes.description: Elder Thorne and the party must decide on a primary strategy. Option A: Fortify and Hold - build defenses, train a militia. Option B: Strike First - take the fight to the Ursillo camp.

outcomes.clean: The village rallies behind your plan. Gain the Village Militia asset.
outcomes.partial: Some villagers are skeptical. You'll need to prove your plan works.
outcomes.miss: The village is divided. Morale suffers. Tick Village Safety +1.

scenes.title: The Final Stand
scenes.description: Garrick Ursillo has gathered all his forces for one final assault on Millhaven. The battle will decide the village's fate. The Ursillo Morale Timer and Village Defense Timer will determine the outcome.

timers.name: Village Defense
timers.description: How well the village holds out

timers.name: Ursillo Morale
timers.description: How close the Ursillo are to breaking and running

outcomes.clean: The village stands. Garrick is defeated. Each PC gains 2 Boons and the Village Trust minor asset.
outcomes.partial: The village holds, but Garrick escapes. He will return.
outcomes.miss: The village falls. The party must flee with survivors. Begin the Refugee Caravan arc.

outcomes.clean: You defeat Garrick in single combat. His gang scatters.
outcomes.partial: Garrick is wounded but escapes. He swears revenge.
outcomes.miss: Garrick overpowers you. You must bargain for your lives.

scenes.title: Aftermath: The Village Stands or Falls
scenes.description: The battle is over. If the village stands, the party has earned a home. If it falls, the survivors must decide where to go next. Tema the Vilikari merchant offers a path forward in either case.

acts.title: Act II: Beyond Millhaven - The Ford of Three Promises
acts.description: The party escorts a grain caravan to the Valvano Ford, where Ykrul herders, Aeler toll-keepers, and Vilikari merchants are locked in a standoff. They must mediate or risk all-out war.

scenes.title: Sorian Tabb's Offer
scenes.description: The party meets Sorian Tabb, a Vilikari caravan master, at the Muddy Stilt. He offers honest work: escort a cargo of grain seed to the monastery of St. Arilan. The pay is modest. The real prize is a Letter of Introduction - a chance to leave Acasia behind.

outcomes.clean: Sorian trusts you. Gain the Letter of Introduction.
outcomes.partial: Sorian offers the job, but asks for a demonstration of your skills first.
outcomes.miss: Sorian withdraws the offer. You must find another way.

scenes.title: Arrival at the Valvano Ford
scenes.description: The ford is closed. A silence furlong seals the east bank. A keystone clause locks the bridge. A Black Banner mercenary counts coin while three factions refuse to move. The party must break the deadlock.

timers.name: Ford Standoff
timers.description: How long until the standoff collapses

outcomes.clean: You understand each faction's true needs. Gain +1 die to all social rolls against them.
outcomes.partial: You understand some of the factions' needs.
outcomes.miss: You misread the situation. Tick Ford Standoff +1.

scenes.title: The Three Promises
scenes.description: The party must meet each faction and uncover their hidden needs. The Ykrul demand honor restoration. The Aeler need a face-saving audit. The Vilikari need to hide a salt cache. The Black Banner needs payment. Mediation will require leveraging these needs against each other.

outcomes.clean: Sarnai respects your directness. She offers a Ykrul Guide as an asset.
outcomes.partial: Sarnai agrees to talk, but her terms are stiff.
outcomes.miss: Sarnai dismisses you as a foreigner. Tick Ford Standoff +1.

outcomes.clean: Voss reveals his audit anxiety. You have leverage.
outcomes.partial: Voss is evasive. You learn something, but not everything.
outcomes.miss: Voss clams up. Tick Ford Standoff +1.

outcomes.clean: Rusk names his price. You can pay it or negotiate.
outcomes.partial: Rusk gives you a deadline. Tick Ford Standoff +1 if you miss it.
outcomes.miss: Rusk sides with the highest bidder. Tick Ford Standoff +1.

scenes.title: The Mediation
scenes.description: The moot is held. The party must bring the factions to agreement. Every success cools the standoff; every failure advances the timer. If the timer fills, the standoff collapses into violence.

outcomes.clean: The ford opens. The parties agree. Gain Strings with all three factions.
outcomes.partial: A partial agreement is reached. The ford opens, but tensions remain.
outcomes.miss: The moot fails. Roll on the First Striker table.

scenes.title: The Road Ahead
scenes.description: The ford is open. The party has earned a reputation as negotiators. Tema offers a share in her future profits. The road to the Bronze Gate lies ahead, carrying rumors of a cursed seal and a heist.

acts.title: Act III: The Brass Gate - Heist, Curse, and the Fall of the Ninth Legion
acts.description: The party is hired by Tema to steal the Iron Seal of Varus from Prefect Marcellus's tribunal. The seal can bind oaths with a wasting curse - and Marcellus intends to use it on the Ykrul. The party must navigate a heist, a curse, and the politics of Castra Ferrum.

scenes.title: Tema's Warehouse - The Job
scenes.description: Tema offers a fortune in silver to retrieve the Iron Seal of Varus from the Prefect's tribunal. She wants to give it to Khatun Sarnai as a peace offering, opening the steppe trade route. The party must choose: accept the job, or find another path.

timers.name: Heist Timer
timers.description: When full, Quick Lena steals the seal first

outcomes.clean: Tema trusts you. Gain Tema's Trust asset.
outcomes.partial: Tema offers the job, but asks for a demonstration of your skills.
outcomes.miss: Tema withdraws the offer. You must find another way.

scenes.title: The Bronze Gate - A Tour of Factions
scenes.description: The party must navigate the politics of Castra Ferrum. Prefect Marcellus commands the tribunal. Censor Cassia watches from the archives. Khatun Sarnai camps outside the walls. Captain Rusk sells steel to whoever can pay. Quick Lena is already casing the tribunal.

outcomes.clean: Marcellus offers you a job. Accepting starts his Debt Timer.
outcomes.partial: Marcellus is interested, but suspicious.
outcomes.miss: Marcellus dismisses you. He will remember your faces.

outcomes.clean: Cassia offers a counter-job. She wants Marcellus exposed.
outcomes.partial: Cassia gives you a lead, but demands a favor.
outcomes.miss: Cassia refuses to speak with you.

outcomes.clean: Sarnai remembers you from the ford. She offers a Ykrul Guide.
outcomes.partial: Sarnai agrees to talk, but her daughter Yelü challenges you to a horse race.
outcomes.miss: Sarnai refuses to trust outsiders.

scenes.title: The Tribunal Heist
scenes.description: The party must infiltrate the Prefect's tribunal and steal the Iron Seal of Varus. Quick Lena is already inside, working for Captain Rusk. The Watch Patrol timer advances on failed Stealth rolls. The Heist Timer advances each downtime scene.

outcomes.clean: You bypass the trap. A curse tablet reveals Marcellus has been using the seal to curse rivals. Gain a String: Marcellus's Treason.
outcomes.partial: You trigger a bell, but escape the net. Tick Watch Patrol +1.
outcomes.miss: The trap catches you. Tick Watch Patrol +2.

outcomes.clean: You find a map of the city and a forged census tablet. Gain another String.
outcomes.partial: You find one of the two items.
outcomes.miss: A guard finds you. Combat begins.

outcomes.clean: You reach the seal first. Quick Lena is still trying to crack the lock.
outcomes.partial: You arrive at the same time as Lena. A tense standoff ensues.
outcomes.miss: Lena has already taken the seal. You must chase her.

scenes.title: The Curse Unsealed
scenes.description: The seal is in the party's possession - but it carries the old curse. Anyone who sleeps near it must test Spirit+Resolve or gain Varus's Whispers. The curse worsens each night. The party must decide how to break the curse: return it to the Ykrul, destroy it with fire, or bind it with a new oath.

outcomes.clean: Sarnai buries the seal under a cairn. The curse ends. Sarnai opens the trade route. Gain Sarnai's Oath.
outcomes.partial: The ritual is incomplete. The curse lingers, but weaker.
outcomes.miss: The ritual fails. The seal must be destroyed or bound.

outcomes.clean: The seal shatters. The curse ends. Gain a Censor's Seal.
outcomes.partial: The seal shatters, but the curse transfers to the one who struck it. That PC gains Varus's Scourge.
outcomes.miss: The seal is damaged but not destroyed. The curse intensifies.

outcomes.clean: A treaty is sworn between Marcellus, Sarnai, and Tema. The curse transforms into a blessing. Gain Strings with all three factions.
outcomes.partial: A partial treaty is sworn. The curse is weakened, but not gone.
outcomes.miss: The oath-swearing fails. Marcellus's cultists attack.

outcomes.clean: You summon the ghost of the Ninth Legion's commander. He speaks his own name, ending the curse forever. Gain a Legendary String: The Ninth Legion's Gratitude.
outcomes.partial: The ghost appears but requires a sacrifice.
outcomes.miss: The ghost attacks. Combat begins.

scenes.title: The Gate Opens
scenes.description: At dawn, the portcullis rises. The Ykrul riders wait. The merchants line up with their carts. The legionaries salute. The party has earned a place in Fate's Edge.

outcomes.clean: Tema gives you a silver medallion. 'Show this to any Vilikari trader. They will know you are trusted.'
outcomes.partial: The gate opens, but not everyone is satisfied.
outcomes.miss: The gate opens, but the party is marked as troublemakers.

npcs.name: Elder Thorne
npcs.motivation: Protect his people at all costs
npcs.secret: He knows the old Imperial bridge was the site of a broken promise. He still leaves milk on the bridge steps every full moon.

npcs.name: Mira the Baker
npcs.motivation: Feed her family and keep the community together
npcs.secret: Her grandmother was the last person to see the tax collector before he vanished. She knows where the broken promise was sworn.

npcs.name: Tom the Smith
npcs.motivation: Protect his forge and the tools that feed his family

npcs.name: Tema
npcs.motivation: Open the steppe trade route, save her business
npcs.secret: She has invested everything in this trade route. If the seal is not recovered, she will be ruined.

npcs.name: Sorian Tabb
npcs.motivation: Get the grain seeds to the monastery before the first frost

npcs.name: Old Kes
npcs.motivation: Keep the Silk Coin's principles alive
npcs.secret: He taught the exiles to keep their word even when it cost everything.

npcs.name: Mareth
npcs.motivation: Guide the exiles, atone for past mistakes
npcs.secret: They were a Runekeeper of the Traveler, expelled for unlocking forbidden way-routes.

locations.name: Silkstrand
locations.description: A city of bridges and canals where favours are measured in threads. The Matron rules, but the Ragman, Tide Father, and Silk Mother hold the underworld. The ninth bridge leads to the Sunken Quarter.

locations.name: Millhaven
locations.description: A small farming community in the Acasian marches. The village sits in a fertile valley surrounded by rolling hills, its thatched-roof cottages clustered around a central square where the weekly market is held.

locations.name: The Old Imperial Bridge
locations.description: A bridge over the millstream with nine arches. The locals count only eight. The ninth arch is there, but they will not look at it. The site of a broken promise - a tax collector swore an oath on his child's life and then defaulted.

locations.name: The Pale Causeway
locations.description: The last high road that survives the spring thaws in Acasia. The causeway is made of bones - the bones of the workers who built it. Crossing the Causeway at dusk forces a Resolve test (DV 4).

locations.name: The Valvano Ford
locations.description: A contested crossing where Ykrul herders, Aeler toll-keepers, and Vilikari merchants stare at one another across a span of gray stone. The bridge has nine arches. The locals count only eight.

locations.name: Castra Ferrum
locations.description: A walled city built atop a Ykrul burial ground. The Bronze Gate is the only pass through the mountains for three weeks' march. Ecktorian officers, tax farmers, and priest-magistrates hold sway through a web of patronage.

locations.name: The Bronze Gate
locations.description: A portcullis of bronze-banded iron, etched with the names of every legionary who died defending it. A Censor's clerk keeps the Ledger of Blood - a book recording every soul who passes. The Ykrul call it the Weeping Gate.

locations.name: The Praetorium
locations.description: The fortified hall where Prefect Marcellus holds his tribunal. Inside, the Iron Seal of Varus rests in a lead-lined chest on an altar to Mars.

locations.name: The Archive
locations.description: A labyrinth of scrolls and curse tablets awaiting destruction. Censor Cassia's office is filled with the weight of history and secrets.

factions.name: The Silk Coin
factions.goals: A principled thieves' guild that kept its word even when it cost everything. Now fallen.
factions.relationship: The characters are exiles who carry the Silk Coin's legacy.

factions.name: The Velvet Court
factions.goals: Control Silkstrand's underworld through velvet gloves and iron fists.
factions.relationship: The characters are enemies of the Velvet Court. Madam Serafine erased them from Silkstrand.

factions.name: The Ursillo Gang
factions.goals: Extract 'protection money' from villages, grow their power in Acasia.
factions.relationship: The characters have defeated them in Millhaven. Garrick Ursillo may return.

factions.name: The Vilikari Traders
factions.goals: Open trade routes, profit from grain and goods.
factions.relationship: The characters have Tema as an ally and Sorian Tabb as a contact.

factions.name: The Ykrul Gray Ash Clan
factions.goals: Protect their people, restore clan honor, reopen trade.
factions.relationship: The characters have negotiated with Khatun Sarnai and may have earned her trust.

factions.name: The Aeler Guild
factions.goals: Maintain the toll rights and charter at Valvano Ford.
factions.relationship: The characters have negotiated with Factor Voss.

factions.name: The Black Banner Mercenaries
factions.goals: Get paid, get out. Sell steel to whoever can pay.
factions.relationship: The characters have dealt with Captain Rusk, who may be an enemy or ally.

factions.name: The Ecktorian Tribunal
factions.goals: Enforce order, control the Bronze Gate, use the seal to force oaths.
factions.relationship: Prefect Marcellus is a major antagonist.

campaignTimers.name: The Hollow's Attention
campaignTimers.description: How much the Curse of Acasia has noticed the party. Ticks when characters break Acasian customs, spend 2+ SB on supernatural complications, or swear oaths on bridges or at crossroads.

campaignTimers.name: The Curse of Acasia
campaignTimers.description: A slow accumulation of broken promises and unpaid tolls. Ticks when a contract is broken on a bridge, a character speaks the ninth word in a negotiation, the party ignores a road omen, or a free company flips allegiance.

campaignTimers.name: Ursillo Remnants
campaignTimers.description: How close Garrick Ursillo's remaining forces are to regrouping and seeking revenge.

campaignTimers.name: Political Pressure
campaignTimers.description: External forces trying to manipulate or eliminate the party. Ticks when they make enemies or uncover secrets.

notes: The Blood and Silk saga is a complete campaign arc following exiles from Silkstrand as they defend Millhaven, mediate at the Valvano Ford, and heist the Iron Seal of Varus at the Bronze Gate. The Curse of Acasia is a persistent threat throughout. Key themes: redemption, community, second chances, the weight of exile, and the power of belonging.

pacing.prequel: This is a flashback prologue. The Velvet Court is a looming threat, but its deeper structure (the Silken Blade, the Court's long-term plans) is not revealed yet. Old Kes dies—his sacrifice should feel personal and immediate, not mythologized. The players' choices here create their Legacy Tokens; emphasize consequence over exposition. The ninth bridge (and its curse) can be hinted at but not explained.
pacing.act1: This act is about earning a home through sweat and blood. Focus on the human stakes of Millhaven: the villagers' faces, the weight of their fear, the hope in their eyes. The Curse of Acasia should be a background hum—a strange omen, a whispered story—not a mechanical threat. Elder Thorne's knowledge of the old bridge is a clue, not a solution. Garrick Ursillo is a desperate man, not a monster. His backstory (the Vhasian brand) is a secret to be discovered, not volunteered.
pacing.act2: This act is about mediation and seeing beyond first impressions. Each faction has hidden needs; the party must peel back layers. Sarnai's grief, Voss's desperation, Rusk's debt—these are threads to be pulled, not handed over. The ninth arch of the Valvano Ford can be referenced as a local superstition. The Curse of Acasia becomes more tangible—the standoff itself is a kind of oath-breaking, and the party may feel the weight of their words. Do not reveal Rusk's connection to Varus's badge of rank yet.
pacing.act3: This act is where all the secrets converge. The Iron Seal, the ghost of Varus, Marcellus's cult, Cassia's illness, Rusk's promise, Sarnai's daughter's parentage—all are now available for revelation. The Curse of Acasia is a ticking clock. The three endings (return, destroy, bind) should feel earned based on what the party discovered in Acts I and II. The ghost's Ninth Clause is the ultimate lore reward—do not foreshadow it heavily; let it be a stunning discovery.

npcSecrets.elder-thorne: His secret about the old Imperial bridge is a hook, not a reveal. He may share his ritual (leaving milk on the bridge) as a strange local custom, but the full story of the broken promise should only emerge if players investigate the bridge directly or earn his complete trust.
npcSecrets.mira-baker: Her grandmother's knowledge of the vanished tax collector is a clue that leads to the bridge's curse. This should surface in Act I if players ask about the village's history, but the connection to the Curse of Acasia is an Act II/III realization.
npcSecrets.tema: Her desperation is visible from Act II onward, but her ruin-level investment should be revealed gradually. In Act II, she is a hopeful merchant. In Act III, her urgency reveals the full stakes—if the seal is not recovered, she loses everything.
npcSecrets.captain-rusk: His debt to the smuggler Peyton is a pragmatic detail, not a plot centerpiece. It can surface in Act II during negotiation. His carrying of Varus's badge of rank is a major Act III reveal—do not mention it before the heist. It connects him to the Ninth Legion's fall.
npcSecrets.khatun-sarnai: Her daughter Yelü's parentage is a delicate secret. Sarnai will not volunteer it. If the party earns her trust (e.g., through the Act II mediation or an Act III horse race), she may reveal it privately. This is a moment of vulnerability, not a casual conversation.
npcSecrets.quick-lena: Her past as a Silk Coin apprentice is a sympathetic detail that can surface during the heist, especially if the party recognizes her skills or shares their own exile stories. It creates a potential alliance—or a tragic parallel if they become rivals.
npcSecrets.prefect-marcellus: His cult of oathbreakers is a hard Act III reveal. In Act II, he is a distant rumor. In Act III Scene 2, he appears as a commanding, pragmatic officer—perhaps even likeable. Only during the heist or the curse-ending should his corruption become undeniable. His brother's death in a Ykrul raid explains his hatred, but that is a sympathetic detail, not a justification.
npcSecrets.censor-cassia: Her fatal illness is an Act III revelation that justifies her dangerous counter-offer. She is dying and has nothing to lose. Do not hint at this in Acts I-II—she is merely a diligent archivist until the party earns her trust or breaks into the Archive.
npcSecrets.mareth: Their past as a Runekeeper of the Traveler is a private burden. They may reveal it slowly over the campaign, especially if the party encounters way-routes or gets lost. It is not a secret to guard tightly, but it should be earned through trust and shared hardship.
npcSecrets.old-kes: He is already deceased by the start of the campaign. His legacy is carried by the players. His secret (the principles of the Silk Coin) is the party's inheritance—it defines their moral compass, not a plot twist.

forbiddenEarlyRevelations: The Iron Seal of Varus and its curse mechanics (Act III only)
The Ninth Clause (the ghost's true name ending the curse) — this is a late Act III discovery
Captain Rusk's possession of Varus's badge of rank
Khatun Sarnai's daughter Yelü is a legionary's child
The full mechanics of the Curse of Acasia and The Hollow's Attention timers — hint at the curse as a folk belief, not a mechanical system
The ninth arch of any bridge is the site of a broken promise — this is a recurring motif; mention it as superstition early, but do not explain its deeper magical significance until Act II or III
Garrick Ursillo's Vhasian army brand — it's a visible scar if players look closely, but its meaning is a discovery, not a first-meeting detail
Quick Lena's Silk Coin past — she may recognize the players' style, but she will not volunteer her history
